list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment, 'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment, 'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, target_id AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY target_id

list.name: category_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(category_id, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(category_id, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: advisor_group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: object_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(object_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS __value, coalesce(object_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS __text FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot ORDER BY 1

list.name: priority
list.query: SELECT priority AS __value, priority AS __text FROM (SELECT DISTINCT priority FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot WHERE priority IS NOT NULL) s ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, priority

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', g.collected_at) AS time, coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS metric, count(DISTINCT g.target_id) AS databases
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('minute', g.collected_at) AS time, coalesce(g.category_id, 'UNKNOWN') AS metric, count(*) AS findings
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.category_id, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${category_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.object_type, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${object_type:sqlstring})
  AND g.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Critical findings by database over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', g.collected_at) AS time, g.target_id AS metric, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.priority = 'HIGH' OR g.risk_level = 'HIGH' OR g.action_safety = 'MANUAL_ONLY' OR g.requires_lock IS TRUE OR g.requires_maintenance_window IS TRUE) AS critical_findings
FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
  AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
  AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.category_id, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${category_id:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
  AND coalesce(g.object_type, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${object_type:sqlstring})
  AND g.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.target_id) g.target_id, g.run_id, g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY g.target_id, g.collected_at DESC
),
current_findings AS (
  SELECT g.*, coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS environment
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.target_id = g.target_id AND ls.run_id = g.run_id
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE coalesce(g.category_id, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${category_id:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.object_type, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${object_type:sqlstring})
    AND g.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
)
SELECT environment, count(DISTINCT target_id) AS databases, count(*) AS findings,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') AS high_priority,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high_risk,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE action_safety = 'MANUAL_ONLY') AS manual_only,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_lock IS TRUE) AS requires_lock,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_maintenance_window IS TRUE) AS maintenance_window,
       max(collected_at) AS last_collected_at
FROM current_findings
GROUP BY environment
ORDER BY high_priority DESC, high_risk DESC, findings DESC;

panels.title: Top critical databases in latest snapshot

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.target_id) g.target_id, g.run_id, g.collected_at
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(g.collected_at)
    AND coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND g.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY g.target_id, g.collected_at DESC
),
current_findings AS (
  SELECT g.*, coalesce(r.environment, 'unknown') AS environment
  FROM pga_global_advisor_snapshot g
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls ON ls.target_id = g.target_id AND ls.run_id = g.run_id
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = g.run_id
  WHERE coalesce(g.category_id, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${category_id:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.advisor_group, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${advisor_group:sqlstring})
    AND coalesce(g.object_type, 'UNKNOWN') IN (${object_type:sqlstring})
    AND g.priority IN (${priority:sqlstring})
)
SELECT environment, target_id, count(*) AS findings,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') AS high_priority,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high_risk,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE action_safety = 'MANUAL_ONLY') AS manual_only,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_lock IS TRUE) AS requires_lock,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_maintenance_window IS TRUE) AS maintenance_window,
       max(collected_at) AS last_collected_at,
       (count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') * 100 +
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') * 80 +
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE action_safety = 'MANUAL_ONLY') * 50 +
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_lock IS TRUE) * 40 +
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE requires_maintenance_window IS TRUE) * 30) AS critical_score
FROM current_findings
GROUP BY environment, target_id
ORDER BY critical_score DESC, high_priority DESC, high_risk DESC, findings DESC
LIMIT 50;
